review_notes.evidence: Native full-resolution row0 field crop; F-shaped middle letter independently confirmed by root.
First contacts AU/AW/AY have no printed2C. Final contacts AB/AD/AF have no printed1NO or2NC; none inferred. Output3NO stars appear only keys08–19.
Source AP7 clear, root independently corroborated. A1 is corroboration, not source restoration.
Native footer lacks SDD print; root independently confirmed.
Every right-hand native output/secondary printed hook viewed separately; X is clear. Each physical hook/stub preserved.
Each1NC/2NO and1NO/2NC retains both physical terminals on its source net. Pair rails cross without a diamond at2NO row. Three8-key groups retain separate feedback return paths.
PK031/key27 middle glyph.png; F-shaped middle letter independently confirmed by root.

Source AE1NC/2NO inner rail199, diamondrow68, return75→45→AZ2C; AE1NO/2NC outer200, diamond69, return76→44→AZ1C. This is the actual source swap, separately verified from the first two groups by owner and root. PK031/AE feedback joins.png and third carry lattice.png. No repeated-template substitution.
AA/AC/AE NC-pair diamond is at2NO row+3, not the1NC corner. Other NC-pair diamonds occur atrow+1 where the net continues horizontally.
PK031/AJ output digits.png confirms two closed8 loops. Reduced-view16 candidate withdrawn; independently confirmed by root.

Every mechanical and service block, printed field, physical contact, wire route, junction, separate crossing, external reference, title, revision, footer and connector-table continuation was inspected in this scan. No handwritten annotation is transcribed. Mechanical identifiers are literal field lines, not inferred card portions.

All native two-side/roof anchor crops were visually reviewed. Default 245 × 103 lattice with eight-cell boxes and columns 50,73,96,119,142,165,188. Local border measurements corroborate the lattice; source scan deformation and glyph bearings are calibration effects. Critical source routes were inspected at native resolution rather than assigned from a global affine fit. See native calibration.json and per-page all native border anchors.png. No bank-shift exception.

All footer label/value glyph centres, connector identifiers and address continuations were independently measured against this page native pitch. See native text and rail measurements.json. Header and both vertical page identifiers were inspected; readable printed characters are preserved. PK031 SDD is source blank.

Final preview uses JuliaMono 20, 12-pixel cells and 18-pixel row pitch. Both complete previews, dense carry routes and lower reference/footer sections were inspected. Final independent parent package review remains separate.
